observations: Four pale vertical frames, narrow dark glazing and three brick upper fields form a recognizable interpretation of the dated photo entrance motif.
Brick texture and glazing are resolved and continuous in this view; no obvious missing resources, gross facade detachment or widespread striping.
Frontage fits the raised central roof envelope. Thin exposed red edge along part of the gable trim remains a minor appearance/junction approximation, not measured eave detail.
Large neutral side masses, omitted lower wings/site/steps and absent steeple keep this an incomplete church appearance study.
Uniform brick color, window/door proportions, frame depths and lower entry layout remain estimates; reference photo does not calibrate them.
actual_visual_review.limits: Approval concerns the separate appearance motif only. Underlying sanctuary ends/wallline, campus/legacy overlaps, steeple, currentness and public access remain outside acceptance. No whole-building or full-ticket closure.
actual_visual_review.operations: Viewed existing saved image after completion; no GPU, restart, editor or source changes.
